name: Adapt Short (Shark)
title: Adapt Short (Shark)
description:
Elevate Your Training with the Adapt Shorts!
 Hey, Iron Rebel fam! Meet your new go-to for both gym sessions and off-day hangs — the Adapt Shorts . Built from the same premium material as our best-selling Adapt Cargo Sweatpants, these shorts deliver unmatched comfort, durability, and mobility. Designed for serious lifters, athletes, and anyone who demands more from their gear, they adapt to every part of your day — from squats to the street.
 The Design:
 Function and versatility come together in the Adapt Shorts. Featuring clean lines, a tall waistband, and our signature tonal embroidered logo, these shorts offer a modern, athletic fit with a subtle edge. The premium drawstring and reinforced seams ensure a secure fit that stays in place through your toughest sessions. Whether you're chasing PRs or kicking back, these shorts have you covered.
 Key Features:
 Premium Fabric Blend: The same soft yet durable material you love from our Adapt Cargo Sweatpants — lightweight, breathable, and built to move with you.
 Functional Pockets: Deep side pockets keep your essentials secure without added bulk.
 Tailored Fit: Designed with a slightly tapered leg and mid-thigh cut for unrestricted movement and a flattering, athletic look.
 Adjustable Waistband: The wide waistband and 3/16" drawstring provide all-day comfort and custom fit.
 Tonal Detailing: Minimal branding with an embroidered logo for a sleek, versatile finish.
 Benefits:
 Move freely through squats, deadlifts, and any workout without restriction.
 Stay cool and comfortable from warm-ups to post-training meals.
 Look as strong as you feel — performance built for the platform, style made for everywhere else.

description:
The Iron Rebel Flagship Joggers combine premium cotton with just the right amount of stretch for exceptional comfort and flexibility. Crafted from a soft, cotton-Lycra blend, they deliver a smooth, breathable feel with the freedom to move through every part of your day. 
 Featuring a modern athletic silhouette and signature Iron Rebel detailing, these joggers strike the perfect balance between performance and everyday style. From training sessions to recovery days, they're an essential you'll keep reaching for. 
 DETAILS 
 Premium Cotton Blend — 95% cotton and 5% Lycra for softness, flexibility, and comfort. 
 Lightweight Comfort — 280 GSM fabric offers a breathable feel without sacrificing quality. 
 Flexible Fit — Added stretch allows for natural, unrestricted movement. 
 Athletic Silhouette — A clean, modern fit designed for everyday versatility. 
 Signature Iron Rebel Detail — Subtle branded label for a refined finish. 
 Everyday Versatility — Ideal for training, travel, recovery, and casual wear.

 Our Hulk Cut Tee is designed to show off your delts, lats, and traps, with a cut that highlights your chest without any wardrobe malfunctions. The sides are precisely cut to give you plenty of room to move while providing coverage where you want it.

title: PerformX Shorts (Ocean)
description:
PerformX Shorts
 Built for athletes who demand comfort without sacrificing performance, the PerformX Shorts are engineered to move with you through every workout. Whether you're hitting heavy squats, knocking out conditioning, crushing a hike, or simply taking it easy, these shorts are designed to keep you comfortable every step of the way.
 THE FABRIC
 Made from lightweight 100% polyester , the PerformX Shorts offer exceptional breathability and unrestricted mobility. The moisture-wicking fabric helps keep you cool and dry during intense training while remaining comfortable enough for all-day wear.
 THE DESIGN
 We took everything lifters loved about the original PerformX Shorts and made them even better.
 Made with a 6 inch inseam, giving you a modern athletic fit that lands around mid-quad for added coverage. The crotch has been slightly opened up to provide more room where it matters most, eliminating unnecessary restriction during squats, deadlifts, and everyday movement.
 Deeper pockets securely hold your phone, keys, and other essentials without them bouncing out during activity, while the slightly tapered waistband creates a cleaner, more athletic silhouette. Finished with the signature IRON REBEL logo on the left thigh, these shorts deliver a clean look that performs as hard as you do.

 Lightweight, breathable performance fabric

 Perfect for lifting, running, hiking, training, or everyday wear

 The Embossed Shorts combine premium comfort, athletic performance, and clean, understated style. Whether you're crushing a workout, relaxing on a recovery day, or heading out after the gym, these shorts are built to keep up with your lifestyle.
 Constructed from a premium 70% cotton / 30% polyester fleece blend, they feature an ultra-soft interior for all-day comfort and a durable, tight-knit exterior that holds up through your toughest training sessions. The athletic fit sits closer through the thighs for a streamlined look, while the 5-inch inseam provides unrestricted movement for squats, leg day, and everything in between.
 Finished with subtle embossed branding, branded drawcords, and a premium YKK zippered rear pocket, these shorts deliver the quality and attention to detail you've come to expect from Iron Rebel.
 Why You'll Love Them
 Premium Comfort
 Ultra-soft fleece interior provides exceptional comfort whether you're training, recovering, or wearing them all day.
 Built to Last
 A tightly woven outer fabric resists wear and tear while maintaining its shape workout after workout.
 Move Without Restriction
 The athletic cut and 5-inch inseam provide maximum mobility without excess fabric getting in your way.
 Secure Storage
 A premium YKK zippered rear pocket keeps your phone, wallet, keys, or other essentials safely stored while you're on the move.
 Clean, Premium Details
 The embossed IR logo and branded drawstrings create a subtle, elevated look that pairs perfectly with the rest of the Embossed Collection.
 Features
 Premium 70% cotton / 30% polyester fleece
 Pre-shrunk fabric
 Ultra-soft fleece interior
 Durable tight-knit exterior
 Athletic fit
 5" inseam
 Elastic waistband
 Branded IRON REBEL drawstrings
 Hemmed leg opening with side split for improved mobility
 Embossed IR logo
 Premium YKK zippered rear pocket
 Sizing
 These shorts have an athletic, slim fit and run small. If you're between sizes or prefer a more relaxed fit, we recommend sizing up.
 Care
 Machine wash cold or warm. Tumble dry low or medium. Do not iron.

IR Barbell Club Hoodie - Oat: The Perfect Blend of Style and Comfort! 
 Unleash your inner strength with the IR Barbell Club Hoodie in Oat —the ultimate hoodie designed specifically for bodybuilders, powerlifters, and fitness enthusiasts. This hoodie combines comfort, style, and functionality, making it an essential addition to your workout wardrobe.
 Key Features: 
 Supreme Comfort : Made from a soft, high-quality fabric blend, this hoodie provides a cozy feel that’s perfect for warming up, cooling down, or lounging between sets. Enjoy unrestricted movement as you tackle your toughest workouts!
 Timeless Design : The classic oat color offers a versatile look that pairs well with any gym gear. Whether you’re hitting the weights or grabbing a post-workout smoothie, this hoodie keeps you looking fresh and stylish.

 Shop Now : Don’t wait! Level up your fitness wardrobe with the IR Barbell Club Hoodie in Oat and experience the perfect combination of style and comfort that keeps you motivated through every workout.

Maintain the excellence of your hoodie by washing it inside out with cold water and a mild detergent. For lasting comfort and style, tumble dry on low.

name: Elite Henley (Ivory/Teal)
title: Elite Henley (Ivory/Teal)
description:
Unleash your style and performance with our  Elite Henley in classic Black! Designed for athletes who demand both function and fashion, this versatile shirt is perfect for hitting the gym, lounging around, or even casual outings with friends. With its unique blend of comfort and durability, the  Elite Henley is a staple for your wardrobe.
 Key Features: 
 High-Quality Fabric: Crafted from a soft, breathable cotton-poly blend that ensures maximum comfort during your workouts. Say goodbye to chafing and hello to all-day wear!
 Stylish Design: The modern Henley style with contrasting ivory buttons adds a touch of flair to your fitness wardrobe, making it a standout piece for any occasion.
 Flexible Fit: Designed for a relaxed yet flattering fit, allowing for a full range of motion whether you're lifting, running, or stretching.
 Durable Construction: Built to withstand the rigors of intense training sessions, this Henley is made to last through countless workouts.
 Benefits: 
 Stay cool and comfortable with moisture-wicking properties that keep sweat at bay.
 Look great and feel confident while you crush your goals, whether in the gym or out on the town.
 Enjoy versatile styling options—pair it with shorts for a workout or jeans for a night out.
 Use Cases: 
 Perfect for weightlifting, CrossFit, or any high-intensity training session where comfort is key.
 Great for casual outings, allowing you to transition effortlessly from the gym to social events.
 Ideal for layering under hoodies or jackets when the temperature drops.
 Make a statement with the Elite Henley. Elevate your fitness wardrobe today and show the world that style and performance can go hand in hand!
 Material: 46% Polyester 46% Cotton 8% Elastane

name: Competition Tee (Black)
title: Competition Tee (Black)
description:
Competition Tee
 Every training session, every early morning, and every sacrifice leads to one moment—meet day. The Iron Rebel Competition Tee was designed for that moment.
 Purpose-built to be worn under your singlet, this competition-ready tee features IRON REBEL lettering and the iconic logo across the upper chest, ensuring your commitment to strength is visible every time you step onto the platform.
 Constructed from a premium cotton-poly blend with a tapered athletic fit, it provides all-day comfort without excess bulk. Whether you're chasing a personal record, a state title, or a world record, the Competition Tee is built to perform alongside you.
 Features
 Official competition tee approved by the USPA and all powerlifting federations
 IRON REBEL lettering and logo across the upper chest for visibility under your singlet
 IR logo on the right sleeve
 IR Shield on the left sleeve
 "GREATNESS IS EARNED" graphic with barbell on the back
 Premium cotton-poly blend for lasting comfort and durability
 Tapered athletic fit
 Unisex sizing
 Specifications

 Fit: Tapered athletic fit

name: Inner Battle Premium Gym T-Shirt (Black)
title: Inner Battle Premium Gym T-Shirt (Black)
description:
True Strength Begins Within. 
 The Inner Battle Premium Tee is a declaration of discipline, resilience, and unshakable mental power. Designed with a striking image of a Greek statue — a timeless symbol of reason, virtue, and stoic endurance — this shirt is for those who train both body and mind.

name: Compression Elbow Sleeves (Snow Camo)
title: Compression Elbow Sleeves (Snow Camo)
description:
Iron Rebel® Compression Elbow Sleeves
 Lightweight Compression. Maximum Support.
 The original Iron Rebel® Compression Elbow Sleeves are designed to provide targeted compression and support for your elbows, forearms, and biceps without restricting your natural range of motion. Whether you're pressing heavy weight, recovering from an injury, or looking for extra stability during training, these sleeves deliver the perfect balance of comfort, support, and performance.
 Constructed from premium elastic compression material, they maintain their shape and compression through countless workouts while helping reduce pain, improve circulation, and provide confidence under the bar.
 Features
 Provides targeted compression for elbows, forearms, and biceps
 Helps reduce elbow pain and discomfort during training
 Supports recovery from tendonitis, strains, sprains, and overuse injuries
 Helps promote circulation and reduce muscle fatigue
 Maintains full range of motion while providing consistent support
 Premium high-grade elastic material that won't lose its compression
 5.5" length
 Can be worn on the forearm, elbow, or bicep
 Sold as a pair
 Sizing
 Please read carefully before ordering. 
 Iron Rebel® Compression Elbow Sleeves are available in ½-inch size increments to provide a precise fit. Proper sizing is essential for the correct amount of compression and support.
 How to Measure 
 Using a soft measuring tape, measure:
 Around your elbow joint
 Around the largest part of your forearm
 Keep your arm relaxed and straight while measuring. Do not bend or flex your arm.
 Examples
 Example 1 
 Elbow: 12.5"
 Forearm: 13"
 Recommended Size: 13" 
 Example 2 
 Elbow: 12.5"
 Forearm: 12.5"
 Recommended Size: 12.5" 
 For an extra-tight compression fit , you may choose the smaller of your two measurements.
 Care Instructions
 Hand wash using warm water and a mild detergent.
 Rinse thoroughly.
 Air dry only.
 Do not machine wash or machine dry.
 Size Exchanges
 Need a different size? We make exchanges easy. Please visit our Shipping & Returns page for complete instructions before sending your sleeves back.
 Shipping & Returns:
 https://ironrebel.com/pages/shipping-returns

name: Adapt Short (Black Camo)
title: Adapt Short (Black Camo)
description:
Elevate Your Training with the Adapt Shorts!
 Hey, Iron Rebel fam! Meet your new go-to for both gym sessions and off-day hangs — the Adapt Shorts . Built from the same premium material as our best-selling Adapt Cargo Sweatpants, these shorts deliver unmatched comfort, durability, and mobility. Designed for serious lifters, athletes, and anyone who demands more from their gear, they adapt to every part of your day — from squats to the street.
 The Design:
 Function and versatility come together in the Adapt Shorts. Featuring clean lines, a tall waistband, and our signature tonal embroidered logo, these shorts offer a modern, athletic fit with a subtle edge. The premium drawstring and reinforced seams ensure a secure fit that stays in place through your toughest sessions. Whether you're chasing PRs or kicking back, these shorts have you covered.
 Key Features:
 Premium Fabric Blend: The same soft yet durable material you love from our Adapt Cargo Sweatpants — lightweight, breathable, and built to move with you.
 Functional Pockets: Deep side pockets keep your essentials secure without added bulk.
 Tailored Fit: Designed with a slightly tapered leg and mid-thigh cut for unrestricted movement and a flattering, athletic look.
 Adjustable Waistband: The wide waistband and 3/16" drawstring provide all-day comfort and custom fit.
 Tonal Detailing: Minimal branding with an embroidered logo for a sleek, versatile finish.
 Benefits:
 Move freely through squats, deadlifts, and any workout without restriction.
 Stay cool and comfortable from warm-ups to post-training meals.
 Look as strong as you feel — performance built for the platform, style made for everywhere else.

description:
Built to Withstand. Made to Push Further. 
 The Prep Mode Tee is for those who don’t flinch in the face of pain, pressure, or setbacks. Featuring a raw, striking skull design — a timeless symbol of perseverance — this shirt embodies the mindset of those who are willing to do whatever it takes. The back features a quote made by the late John Meadows 'I was never afraid of brutally hard work. To achieve your best you must simply give it your all. Period'
 The skull isn’t about death. It’s about what doesn’t die — your will. Your grit. Your refusal to quit. This tee stands for the warrior who understands that greatness isn’t glamorous — it’s built in silence, forged in failure, and sharpened through consistency.
 Made from premium, performance-focused fabric, the Prep Mode is tough enough for your hardest days and clean enough to wear with pride beyond the gym. Whether you're grinding through your final rep or pushing past mental limits, this shirt reminds you: comfort is a trap — keep going.

name: Performance Knee Sleeves (PKS)
title: Performance Knee Sleeves (PKS)
description:
About Performance Knee Sleeves 
 Iron Rebel® Performance Knee Sleeves deliver the support, warmth, and rebound lifters rely on to train harder, stay pain-free, and feel locked-in under heavy weight.
 When you're pushing yourself to the limit with squats, deadlifts, or any heavy lifting, you need knee support that keeps up with your training. That’s why we created the  Iron Rebel® Performance Knee Sleeves (PKS) .
 We intentionally engineered these sleeves with high-grade 7mm neoprene , giving you max support and stability while still being comfortable and flexible enough to use everyday.
 The PKS offer a perfect combination of tight compression , stability , and comfort to boost your performance and help protect your knees during the most intense workouts. 
 Key Features:
 7mm Neoprene Thickness : Provides the ideal balance of support and flexibility for heavy lifters, bodybuilders, and powerlifters.
 Heavy Duty Polyester Thread : Built to stretch and accommodate larger quads and calves without losing durability. Perfect for athletes with muscular legs.
 Lateral & Back Support Seams : Ensures maximum compression and stability around the knee for ultimate performance.

 30 cm Length : Provides full knee and thigh coverage for enhanced joint protection.

 Benefits:

name: Outlaw Wrist Wraps
title: Outlaw Wrist Wraps
description:
Iron Rebel® Outlaw Wrist Wraps
 Get to Your PRs Faster
 The Iron Rebel® Outlaw Wrist Wraps are built for lifters who refuse to compromise. Our stiffest, most supportive wrist wraps deliver aggressive, cast-like stability to help keep your wrists locked in under heavy loads, giving you the confidence to attack bigger lifts.
 For over a decade, Iron Rebel has been trusted by elite powerlifters, strongmen, and strength athletes who demand uncompromising performance. Through years of athlete feedback and continuous refinement, the Outlaw Wrist Wraps have evolved to provide the ideal balance of aggressive support, durability, and comfort—without sacrificing the extreme stability they're known for.
 Whether you're chasing a new bench press PR or pressing maximum weight overhead, the Outlaws are engineered to perform when every pound matters.
 Why You'll Love Them
 Get to Your PRs Faster
 Aggressive, cast-like support helps keep your wrists locked in under heavy loads, allowing you to focus on driving more weight.
 Maximum Wrist Stability
 Our stiffest wrist wraps minimize wrist movement to promote stronger, more stable pressing mechanics during your heaviest lifts.
 Trusted by Elite Strength Athletes
 Tested by some of the world's strongest powerlifters and strongmen in training and on the competition platform.
 Built for Years of Heavy Training
 Premium elastic, reinforced stitching, and industrial-strength Velcro deliver long-lasting performance through countless training sessions.
 Features
 Iron Rebel's stiffest wrist wrap for maximum support
 Premium elastic/cotton blend for the ideal balance of stiffness and controlled stretch
 Cast-like feel for exceptional wrist stability
 Dual thumb-loop design fits either wrist
 Available in 18", 26", and 36" lengths
 3" wide with a 2.5" industrial-strength Velcro closure
 Sold as a pair

 Universal Fit – Built for lifters, not posers

name: Iron Rebel® Ice Shaker®
title: Iron Rebel® Ice Shaker®
description:
Time to upgrade from the old smelly plastic shakers!! Say hello to the kitchen grade, non-odor absorbing stainless steel Ice Shaker™ bottle. Ice Shaker's sturdy, leak proof BPA free pop top is easy to open while still being secure enough to close and shake. The Ice Shaker's 26 oz double wall vacuum insulated bottle will hold ice for over 30 hours in a 75 degree room when filled with just ice! The Ice Shaker features a removable twist in agitator for more mixing power, a sturdy handle for easy carrying and fill lines inside the bottle for measuring.
 Easy to hold carrying handle, easy open pop top and comes with a removable agitator that twists into the lid - The shaker lid blends protein powder with ease.
 Premium Quality Double Wall Vacuum Insulated Protein Shaker Bottle that will keep your drink hot for up to 12 hours or cold for 30+ hours. 
 Kitchen grade premium stainless steel cup that does not absorb odor. No more smelly plastic shaker bottles! Odor resistant metal cup makes it perfect for pre workout, juices, protein powder shakes, BCAAs, coffee, smoothies, martinis, cocktails, ice tea, and water. 
 Sweat proof bottle, no more wet cold hands and sweat rings all over your tables. The double wall vacuum insulated bottle prevents condensation from building up on the bottle by preventing cold or heat from transferring to the outside of the bottle.

name: Outlaw Knee Wraps
title: Outlaw Knee Wraps
description:
Iron Rebel® Outlaw Knee Wraps
 Built for Bigger Squats. Engineered for Maximum Rebound.
 The Iron Rebel® Outlaw Knee Wraps are built for lifters who refuse to settle. Our stiffest and most aggressive knee wraps deliver extreme stopping power, explosive rebound, and a cast-like feel to help you stay tighter, drive harder out of the hole, and attack heavier squats with confidence.
 For over 16 years, Iron Rebel has been trusted by elite powerlifters and strength athletes around the world. The Outlaw Knee Wraps represent the highest level of support in our lineup, engineered for experienced lifters who demand maximum performance from every squat.
 Whether you're training for your next PR or stepping onto the competition platform, the Outlaws are built to perform when every pound matters.
 Why You'll Love Them
 Get to Bigger Squats
 Extreme stopping power and explosive rebound help you maximize every squat, giving you the confidence to attack heavier weights.
 Maximum Support
 Our stiffest knee wraps create a cast-like feel to keep your knees stable and supported under maximum loads.
 Built for Elite Performance
 Designed for experienced powerlifters and strength athletes who demand the highest level of support from their knee wraps.
 Training & Competition Ready
 From heavy training sessions to meet day, the Outlaws deliver uncompromising performance when it counts.
 Built for Years of Heavy Lifting
 Premium high-density material is engineered to withstand years of heavy training while maintaining exceptional support.
 Features
 Iron Rebel's stiffest and most aggressive knee wraps
 Premium high-density construction for maximum support and rebound
 Cast-like feel with exceptional stopping power and explosive pop out of the hole
 Designed for advanced and competitive lifters
 Can be self-wrapped, with maximum performance achieved when wrapped by a coach or training partner
 Hand wash with mild soap and air dry
 Do not machine wash or store tightly rolled to maximize product lifespan
 Sold as a pair
 When Every Pound Matters
 When the goal is your biggest squat, every detail counts. The Iron Rebel® Outlaw Knee Wraps are built to provide the stability, rebound, and confidence serious lifters need to push past their limits and perform at their highest level.

 Balanced stretch and support for versatile training
 Durable, high-quality materials
 Easy-to-remove thumb loop
 Can be worn on either right or left wrist
 Sold as a pair

 Bench press and overhead pressing
 Strongman events
 Bodybuilding and hypertrophy training
 General strength and fitness workouts

name: PR Contour Knee Sleeves
title: PR Contour Knee Sleeves
description:
PR CONTOUR KNEE SLEEVES 
 Maximum stiffness. Contoured fit. Built for serious weight. 
 The PR Contour Knee Sleeves are engineered for powerlifters who demand an aggressive 7mm sleeve for heavy training and competition. 
 Constructed from ultra-dense neoprene, the PR Contour features a specialized contoured shape that allows more room through the quads and calves while fitting tighter around the knee . The result is a secure, locked-in feel with exceptional stability and rebound when the weight gets heavy. 
 Tested and trusted by some of the strongest athletes in the world , these sleeves are built to perform under maximal loads and help you attack your biggest lifts with confidence. 
 KEY FEATURES 
 Ultra-Dense 7mm Neoprene 
 Exceptionally stiff construction designed for heavy squats and maximal loads. 
 Contoured Fit 
 More room through the quads and calves with a tighter fit around the knee. 
 Powerful Rebound 
 Designed to provide aggressive support out of the bottom of the squat when every pound counts. 
 Locked-In Stability 
 Keeps the knee supported and secure throughout heavy training and competition lifts. 
 Heavy-Duty Construction 
 Reinforced dual seams built to withstand demanding training and repeated use. 
 Competition Specs 
 7mm thickness 
 30cm length 
 Sold as a pair 
 Federation Approved 
 Approved for USPA, USAPL and most powerlifting federations. Not IPF approved. 
 PR CONTOUR OR PR KNEE SLEEVE? 
 Both PR models are built for lifters who want serious stiffness, support and performance. The difference is the fit. 
 Choose the PR Contour Knee Sleeve if you prefer a shaped fit with more room through the quads and calves and a tighter feel around the knee. 
 Choose the PR Knee Sleeve if you prefer a traditional straight fit with consistent compression throughout the length of the sleeve. 
 Same elite-level performance. Two different fits. 
 MEASUREMENT INSTRUCTIONS 
 ➤ Using a soft tape measure and keeping your leg straight, measure the circumference of your knee joint , the thickest part of your calf , and the bottom of your quad approximately 2–3 inches above the knee . 
 ➤ Use your knee measurement as the primary reference when selecting your size. Calf and quad measurements should be used as secondary references. If you fall between sizes, size up . 
 ➤ The PR Contour Knee Sleeves are extremely stiff and tight by design and may require significant effort to put on and remove. If the sleeves cause numbness, tingling, or loss of sensation, remove them promptly. 
 ➤ Do not cut the sleeves off unless absolutely necessary. Sleeves that have been cut are not eligible for replacement or warranty coverage. 
 ONE-YEAR WARRANTY 
 We offer a one-year warranty against defects in materials or manufacturing . The warranty does not cover normal wear and tear, improper use, damage caused during removal, or sleeves that have been cut.

name: IR Cable Cuffs
title: IR Cable Cuffs
description:
Iron Rebel Cable Cuffs 
 Built for Athletes That Demand More. 
 Take your cable training to the next level with wrist cuffs engineered for precision, comfort, and uncompromising performance. 
 Iron Rebel Wrist Cuffs are designed for athletes who want to maximize muscle activation without grip fatigue limiting their performance. Whether you're isolating your shoulders, biceps, and triceps or targeting your glutes with cable kickbacks, these cuffs provide a secure, comfortable connection that lets you focus on every rep. 
 Constructed from heavy-duty nylon and lined with premium neoprene padding, they deliver exceptional durability while protecting your wrists during even the most demanding training sessions. A reinforced stainless steel D-ring provides a secure attachment to virtually any cable machine, giving you the confidence to train harder, lift longer, and push every set to its limit. 
 From upper-body isolation work to lower-body accessory movements, Iron Rebel Wrist Cuffs are built to perform wherever your training takes you. 
 Features 
 Heavy-duty nylon construction for exceptional durability 
 Premium neoprene padding for superior comfort and wrist protection 
 Reinforced stainless steel D-ring for a secure cable machine attachment 
 Eliminates grip fatigue to maximize muscle isolation 
 Perfect for triceps, biceps, shoulders, lateral raises, cable curls, pushdowns, glute kickbacks, and more 
 Built for high-volume training and long-lasting performance 
 One size fits most 
 Sold as a pair 
 Train harder. Isolate better. Perform without limits.

description:
Elevate Your Workout with the Adapt Cargo Sweatpants! 
 Hey, fitness fam! Are you ready to crush your goals in style? Introducing our Adapt Cargo Sweatpants in rich Cocoa—your ultimate companion for workouts, rest days, and everything in between. Designed specifically for bodybuilders, powerlifters, and serious fitness enthusiasts, these sweatpants combine comfort, functionality, and style.
 The Design: 
Functionality meets style with these Adapt Cargo Sweatpants. Featuring ample storage in the Velcro enclosure cargo pockets, these pants effortlessly combine utility with a modern edge. The tall waistband, accompanied by a 3/16" drawstring, not only enhances the overall design but also ensures a secure and comfortable fit. The tonal embroidered logo adds a touch of sophistication, making these sweatpants a versatile and stylish choice for any occasion.
 Key Features: 
 High-Quality Fabric: Made with a soft, durable blend, these sweatpants are built to withstand intense workouts while keeping you cozy.
 Practical Cargo Pockets: With spacious pockets, you can easily carry your essentials—like your phone, keys, or protein bar—so you can focus on your lifts, not your stuff.
 Tailored Fit: The adjustable drawstring and tapered design ensure a secure fit that moves with you, whether you’re hitting the gym or lounging at home.
 Versatile Style: Perfect for both gym sessions and casual outings, these sweatpants offer a sleek look that’s ready for anything.
 Benefits: 
 Enjoy unrestricted movement during squats, deadlifts, and cardio sessions.
 Stay comfortable and stylish, whether you’re in the gym or running errands.
 Feel confident and motivated to take on any challenge!

description:
Built for athletes who want the perfect balance of flexibility and support, the Rebel Wrist Wraps are your go-to training partner for every workout.
 Designed with just the right amount of stretch, these wraps aren't overly stiff, allowing you to find the perfect fit for any lift. Crank them down for maximum wrist stability on heavy presses, or wear them a little looser for everyday training. Whether you're a powerlifter, bodybuilder, strongman, or serious fitness enthusiast, the Rebel Wrist Wraps deliver dependable support without sacrificing comfort.
 PRODUCT FEATURES 
 Balanced Performance: Mid-range support with the perfect amount of stretch
 Customizable Compression: Tighten them down for maximum wrist stability on heavy lifts
 Durable Construction: Premium elastic material built to withstand years of training
 Comfortable Fit: Supportive without feeling overly bulky or restrictive
 Easy On & Off: Removable thumb loop for quick adjustments between sets
 Sold as a Pair 
 From everyday training to max-effort attempts, the Rebel Wrist Wraps provide the confidence and support you need to keep pushing your limits.

name: PR Taper Knee Sleeves
title: PR Taper Knee Sleeves
description:
IMPORTANT: We have resized our PR Knee Sleeves. Please confirm your size using the current size chart below. DO NOT select your size based on a previously purchased pair. 
 The PR Knee Sleeves are engineered for powerlifters who demand an aggressive 7mm sleeve for heavy training and a traditional straight shape 
 Constructed from ultra-dense neoprene, the PR Knee Sleeve features a traditional straight shape that delivers firm compression throughout the length of the sleeve. The rigid construction creates a secure, locked-in feel with exceptional stability and rebound when the weight gets heavy.
 Tested and trusted by some of the strongest athletes in the world, these sleeves are built to perform under maximal loads and help you attack your biggest lifts with confidence.
 KEY FEATURES 
 Ultra-Dense 7mm Neoprene 
 Exceptionally stiff construction designed for heavy squats and maximal loads. 
 Straight Fit 
 Traditional straight construction provides firm compression from the quad through the knee and calf. 
 Powerful Rebound 
 Designed to provide aggressive support out of the bottom of the squat when every pound counts. 
 Locked-In Stability 
 Keeps the knee supported and secure throughout heavy training and competition lifts. 
 Heavy-Duty Construction 
 Built to withstand demanding training and repeated use. 
 Competition Specs 
 7mm thickness 
 30cm length 
 Sold as a pair 
 PR KNEE SLEEVE OR PR CONTOUR? 
 PR Knee Sleeve if you prefer a traditional straight fit with consistent compression throughout the length of the sleeve. 
 PR Contour Knee Sleeve if you prefer a shaped fit with more room through the quads and calves and a tighter feel around the knee. 
 MEASUREMENT INSTRUCTIONS 
 Using a soft tape measure and keeping your leg straight, measure the circumference of your knee joint, the thickest part of your calf, and the bottom of your quad approximately 2–3 inches above the knee.
 Use your knee measurement as the primary reference when selecting your size. Calf and quad measurements should be used as secondary references. If you fall between sizes, size up.
 Do not select your size based on PR Knee Sleeves you've previously purchased. The PR Knee Sleeves have been resized, so please use your current measurements and the size chart below.
 The PR Knee Sleeves are extremely stiff and tight by design and may require significant effort to put on and remove. If the sleeves cause numbness, tingling, or loss of sensation, remove them promptly.
 Do not cut the sleeves off unless absolutely necessary. Sleeves that have been cut are not eligible for replacement or warranty coverage.
 ONE-YEAR WARRANTY 
 We offer a one-year warranty against defects in materials or manufacturing . The warranty does not cover normal wear and tear, improper use, damage caused during removal, or sleeves that have been cut.

name: Iron Rebel Grips
title: Iron Rebel Grips
description:
Iron Rebel® Grips
 Grip Harder. Lift Heavier.
 When your grip gives out, your set is over.
 The Iron Rebel® Grips are built to eliminate grip fatigue so you can focus on what really matters—moving more weight, pushing more reps, and maximizing every workout.
 Whether you're pulling heavy deadlifts, crushing rows, attacking pull-ups, or grinding through back day, these grips provide the security and confidence you need to train at your highest level. Designed with a heavy-duty rubber grip and reinforced wrist support, they lock you into the bar while reducing hand fatigue and improving control.
 From your warm-up sets to your heaviest lifts, Iron Rebel Grips help you keep your focus where it belongs—on building strength.
 Built for Athletes That Demand More
 Every detail was engineered for durability, comfort, and performance.
 Premium Construction
 Built with a single-piece neoprene wrist pad featuring an embossed Iron Rebel exterior for exceptional durability and long-lasting support.
 Superior Comfort & Support
 A soft neoprene interior cushions your wrists while the embossed outer layer adds rigidity, creating a secure and comfortable fit throughout every workout.
 Secure Adjustable Fit
 Heavy-duty hook-and-loop closure allows you to dial in the perfect fit so your grips stay locked in place during every lift.
 Maximum Grip Power
 The textured rubber gripping surface and thumb notch provide outstanding control on barbells, dumbbells, cable attachments, pull-up bars, and more.
 Heavy-Duty Performance
 Engineered to handle the demands of elite training, these grips are built to support lifts exceeding 800 lbs. 
 Train More. Grip Less.
 Reduce grip fatigue so you can continue challenging your target muscles without your hands becoming the limiting factor.
 Perfect For
 Deadlifts
 Barbell & Dumbbell Rows
 Lat Pulldowns
 Pull-Ups & Chin-Ups
 Cable Rows
 Shrugs
 Romanian Deadlifts
 Dumbbell Lunges
 Heavy Carries
 Curls
 Machine Training
 Any exercise where grip strength limits performance
 Features
 Premium embossed neoprene wrist support
 Soft cushioned interior for superior comfort
 Heavy-duty textured rubber grip
 Thumb notch for secure positioning
 Adjustable hook-and-loop wrist closure
 Supports 800+ lb lifts
 Built for serious strength athletes
 Sold as a pair

 Shorter hand strap

 Longer hand strap

 Longer hand strap
 Why Iron Rebel?
 Iron Rebel is trusted by world champions, record holders, and lifters who refuse to settle for average. Every product is designed with one goal in mind: helping you perform at your highest level every time you step into the gym.
 When the weight gets heavy, your grip shouldn't be the reason you stop.
 Iron Rebel® Grips. Built for athletes who demand more.

Our Competition Deadlift Socks are engineered to protect your shins from barbell scratches and cuts, ensuring you can focus on pushing yourself to the next level. Featuring compression for added support, these socks stay in place throughout your entire workout. Crafted from a breathable, moisture-wicking fabric blend of polyester, cotton, and Lycra, they offer comfort and durability. name: Compression Elbow Sleeves (Black Camo)
title: Compression Elbow Sleeves (Black Camo)
description:
Iron Rebel® Compression Elbow Sleeves
 Lightweight Compression. Maximum Support.
 The original Iron Rebel® Compression Elbow Sleeves are designed to provide targeted compression and support for your elbows, forearms, and biceps without restricting your natural range of motion. Whether you're pressing heavy weight, recovering from an injury, or looking for extra stability during training, these sleeves deliver the perfect balance of comfort, support, and performance.
 Constructed from premium elastic compression material, they maintain their shape and compression through countless workouts while helping reduce pain, improve circulation, and provide confidence under the bar.
 Features
 Provides targeted compression for elbows, forearms, and biceps
 Helps reduce elbow pain and discomfort during training
 Supports recovery from tendonitis, strains, sprains, and overuse injuries
 Helps promote circulation and reduce muscle fatigue
 Maintains full range of motion while providing consistent support
 Premium high-grade elastic material that won't lose its compression
 5.5" length
 Can be worn on the forearm, elbow, or bicep
 Sold as a pair
 Sizing
 Please read carefully before ordering. 
 Iron Rebel® Compression Elbow Sleeves are available in ½-inch size increments to provide a precise fit. Proper sizing is essential for the correct amount of compression and support.
 How to Measure 
 Using a soft measuring tape, measure:
 Around your elbow joint
 Around the largest part of your forearm
 Keep your arm relaxed and straight while measuring. Do not bend or flex your arm.
 Examples
 Example 1 
 Elbow: 12.5"
 Forearm: 13"
 Recommended Size: 13" 
 Example 2 
 Elbow: 12.5"
 Forearm: 12.5"
 Recommended Size: 12.5" 
 For an extra-tight compression fit , you may choose the smaller of your two measurements.
 Care Instructions
 Hand wash using warm water and a mild detergent.
 Rinse thoroughly.
 Air dry only.
 Do not machine wash or machine dry.
 Size Exchanges
 Need a different size? We make exchanges easy. Please visit our Shipping & Returns page for complete instructions before sending your sleeves back.
 Shipping & Returns:
 https://ironrebel.com/pages/shipping-returns

title: Embossed Shorts (Mocha)
description:
Embossed Shorts
 Designed for training. Styled for everyday wear. 
 The Embossed Shorts combine premium comfort, athletic performance, and clean, understated style. Whether you're crushing a workout, relaxing on a recovery day, or heading out after the gym, these shorts are built to keep up with your lifestyle.
 Constructed from a premium 70% cotton / 30% polyester fleece blend, they feature an ultra-soft interior for all-day comfort and a durable, tight-knit exterior that holds up through your toughest training sessions. The athletic fit sits closer through the thighs for a streamlined look, while the 5-inch inseam provides unrestricted movement for squats, leg day, and everything in between.

name: HD Knee Sleeves
title: HD Knee Sleeves
description:
Built for Every Heavy Training Day 
 The HD Knee Sleeves were designed for athletes who want serious knee support without the hassle of ultra-stiff competition sleeves. Whether you're chasing bigger squats, leg presses, lunges, or strongman events, these sleeves deliver the warmth, compression, and stability needed to train harder and recover feeling better.
 Comfortable enough for your entire workout and supportive enough for your heaviest sets, they'll quickly become one of the first things you throw in your gym bag.
 Why You'll Love Them
 Train Longer with Less Knee Fatigue
 Compression and joint warmth help your knees feel supported through high-volume training, allowing you to focus on the next rep instead of aching joints.
 Confidence Under Heavy Weight
 The double-ply construction provides the support and rebound needed to attack heavy squats, leg presses, hack squats, and other demanding lower-body movements.
 They Stay Put
 The integrated rubber grip lining helps prevent rolling and slipping, so you spend more time lifting and less time adjusting your sleeves.
 Easy to Put On. Easy to Take Off.
 Unlike extremely stiff competition sleeves, the HD Sleeves offer excellent support while remaining flexible enough for everyday training.
 Built for More Than Squats
 Ideal for bodybuilding, weightlifting, CrossFit®, strongman, functional fitness, and general strength training.
 Features
 Double-ply construction
 Custom elastic/polyester blend
 Internal rubber grip lining
 Comfortable all-day fit
 "Earn Your Spot" interior print
 Sold as a pair

name: Compression Elbow Sleeves (Black)
title: Compression Elbow Sleeves (Black)
description:
Iron Rebel® Compression Elbow Sleeves
 Maximum Compression. Maximum Support.
 The original Iron Rebel® Compression Elbow Sleeves are designed to provide targeted compression and support for your elbows, forearms, and biceps without restricting your natural range of motion. Whether you're pressing heavy weight, recovering from an injury, or looking for extra stability during training, these sleeves deliver the perfect balance of comfort, support, and performance.
 Constructed from premium elastic compression material, they maintain their shape and compression through countless workouts while helping reduce pain, improve circulation, and provide confidence under the bar.
 Features
 Provides targeted compression for elbows, forearms, and biceps
 Helps reduce elbow pain and discomfort during training
 Supports recovery from tendonitis, strains, sprains, and overuse injuries
 Helps promote circulation and reduce muscle fatigue
 Maintains full range of motion while providing consistent support
 Premium high-grade elastic material that won't lose its compression
 5.5" length
 Can be worn on the forearm, elbow, or bicep
 Sold as a pair
 Sizing
 Please read carefully before ordering. 
 Iron Rebel® Compression Elbow Sleeves are available in ½-inch size increments to provide a precise fit. Proper sizing is essential for the correct amount of compression and support.
 How to Measure 
 Using a soft measuring tape, measure:
 Around your elbow joint
 Around the largest part of your forearm
 Keep your arm relaxed and straight while measuring. Do not bend or flex your arm.
 Examples
 Example 1 
 Elbow: 12.5"
 Forearm: 13"
 Recommended Size: 13" 
 Example 2 
 Elbow: 12.5"
 Forearm: 12.5"
 Recommended Size: 12.5" 
 For an extra-tight compression fit , you may choose the smaller of your two measurements.
 Care Instructions
 Hand wash using warm water and a mild detergent.
 Rinse thoroughly.
 Air dry only.
 Do not machine wash or machine dry.
 Size Exchanges
 Need a different size? We make exchanges easy. Please visit our Shipping & Returns page for complete instructions before sending your sleeves back.
 Shipping & Returns:
 https://ironrebel.com/pages/shipping-returns
